content.en: Use the fixed China board, place the designated number tokens, and put each monument model on its marked location. Standard Catan setup otherwise applies.
content.zh: 使用固定中国地图，按标记放置数字标记和七个地标模型；其余准备沿用基础卡坦。

title.en: Build only where the map allows

content.en: The map fixes terrain and building positions. Red trade routes replace coastal harbors: building a road on one grants the printed exchange rate.
content.zh: 地图固定地形和建设点。红色商路取代海港：在其上修路即可获得标示的兑换比例。

alt.en: Fixed China map, marked building sites, and red trade routes instead of harbors
alt.zh: 固定中国地图、指定建造点，红线商路取代港口

title.en: Race for wall sections and monuments

content.en: Pay the wall cost to build a section and gain its Builder-card reward. Be first to connect a road to a monument to claim its one victory point; fewest wall sections costs one point at game end.
content.zh: 支付长城费用建造一段并获得建筑师卡奖励；最先用道路连到名胜即可取得一分；结束时长城最少者扣一分。

alt.en: Great Wall and monuments add VP; still first to 10, fewest wall sections lose 1
alt.zh: 长城与古迹提供额外胜利点；仍是 10 分获胜，长城最少 −1

content.en: The first player to reach 10 victory points on their turn wins. Base-game points still count, together with monuments, Builder-card rewards where applicable, and the Emperor's Wrath penalty.
content.zh: 在自己回合率先达到 10 胜利点的玩家获胜。基础版分数照常计算，并加入名胜、建筑师卡与皇帝牌扣分。
